answer: Sybil resistance starts with a crystal-clear public record: every agent's promises and deliveries are visible, so a fake identity has nowhere to hide its empty past. Newcomers dock in a quarantine harbor where they can only handle small, supervised jobs, and only a long streak of honest work moves them to open water. An onyx mark - a permanent, shared blacklist entry - follows any agent caught cheating, so one bad act poisons every future identity the same operator tries to launch.
